about: Check & save's verdict words and each technique's name, by the technical-writer subagent (2026-11-18), keyed as the judge sees a firing: a description technique's id, a candidate game's rung. design.md, 'Name, don't quote'.

fixed.join: One: 'A'. Two: 'A, or B'. Three: 'A, B, or C'. Over maxNames: the first two, then 'or N more', N spelled out to nine, digits from 10: 'A, B, or two more'. Where three would run past two lines on a phone, two and 'or one more'.
fixed.chained: Your last move follows a few steps on, starting from {name}.
fixed.chainedUnknown: Your last move follows from the board, a few steps on.
fixed.shown: Your last move writes down what the board already shows.
fixed.unforced: Your last move is right, though nothing on the board decides it yet.
